description: Eight knobs that make a poly cable of fixed voltages, or attenuate, invert and offset a poly input, with a voltage controlled amplifier mode

params.text: Sets that channel's value, reading -5V to +5V on a bipolar channel and 0V to 10V on a unipolar one; in the amplifier mode it scales that channel's control voltage instead
Trims every channel at once: in the multiply mode it scales them from full inversion through silence to full level, and in the add mode it shifts them by up to 5V either way
Swaps the eight knobs between channels 1 to 8 and channels 9 to 16
Switches to the amplifier mode, where the output is the input multiplied by the control voltage, scaled by the knobs and the main knob and clamped to ±5V
Sets every channel on the current page to unipolar, so its knob runs from 0V to 10V
Sets every channel on the current page to bipolar, so its knob runs from -5V to +5V
Sets every channel on the current page to add its knob to the input
Sets every channel on the current page to multiply the input by its knob
Chooses whether the main knob multiplies every channel or adds a voltage to it

inputs.text: The signal to be attenuated, inverted or offset, one poly channel per knob; with nothing patched, the knobs give their voltages on their own
Added to the knobs a tenth of a turn per volt, one poly channel per knob; a cable with fewer channels than the output has is wrapped round and reused
Scales the main knob, a tenth per volt, on one channel only

outputs.text: The result, one poly channel per channel the module is set to, clamped to that channel's own range

notes: The eight knobs cover eight channels at a time; the page button swaps them between channels 1 to 8 and channels 9 to 16
Each channel's display can be clicked in three places: the top line sets the output's channel count to that channel, the middle line flips that channel between adding and multiplying
The lower line of a channel's display flips that one channel between unipolar and bipolar
With nothing patched into the output the displays preview the values without sending anything
menu: Processing rate: sample, 1 ms — chooses whether the knobs and CV are read every sample or every millisecond; the amplifier mode always runs every sample
